model_annotation: This pie chart displays the distribution of stimuli types, with a total of six slices representing different categories. The slices are labeled as follows: “Intra-agency news article” (yellow), “Press Release” (light yellow), “Draft/Other” (red), “Email” (dark red), “Organizational Report” (purple), and “External News Article” (green). Accompanying each label is a fraction representing a count out of 38, for example, “Intra-agency news article (1/38)”. The chart includes labels directly on each slice, and the slices appear to be arranged in descending order based on the fraction count, with the "External News Article" slice occupying the largest proportion and “Intra-agency news article” having the smallest. There is no apparent visual emphasis on any particular slice, such as exploding or bolding, and a legend is not present.
